title: Macroscopic origin of the topologically twisted index on $T^2 \times Σ_{\mathfrak{g}}$
summary: We construct a novel family of non-supersymmetric, asymptotically locally AdS$_5$ solutions of five-dimensional minimal gauged supergravity. In Lorentzian signature the solutions describe finite temperature rotating electro-magnetically charged black strings with $S^1\times Σ_{\mathfrak{g}}$ horizon topology. In Euclidean signature the solutions are completely smooth and are asymptotic to $T^2\times Σ_{\mathfrak{g}}$.
